fact: The World Bank's GREAT Project status report lists a new Service Bus for data exchange via APIs among government systems and services including the National Identification Registry, with 0 systems using it at 30 September 2025 against a target of 10 by December 2030.

The GREAT Project procurement plan (Ministry of Finance and Development Planning, World Bank) lists a consultancy to design, install and configure a Government Service Bus prototype, the firm package marked cancelled and an individual-consultant package of US$50,000 marked pending implementation with terms of reference planned for 2026-02-25.
